title: When and Why SignSGD Outperforms SGD: A Theoretical Study Based on $\ell_1$-norm Lower Bounds
abstract: arXiv:2605.06615v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Sign-based optimization algorithms, such as SignSGD and Muon, have garnered significant attention for their remarkable performance in training large foundation models. Despite this empirical success, we still lack a theoretical understanding of when and why these sign-based methods outperform vanilla SGD. The core obstacle is that under standard smoothness and finite variance conditions, SGD is known to be minimax optimal for finding stationary points measured by $\ell_2$-norms, thereby fundamentally precluding any complexity gains for sign-based methods in standard settings. To overcome this barrier, we analyze sign-based optimizers leveraging $\ell_1$-norm stationarity, $\ell_\infty$-smoothness, and a separable noise model, which can better capture the coordinate-wise nature of signed updates. translated_title: 何时以及为何SignSGD优于SGD：基于ℓ₁-范数下界的理论研究
translated_abstract: 基于符号的优化算法，如SignSGD和Muon，因其在训练大型基础模型中的卓越表现而受到广泛关注。尽管取得了这些实证成功，我们仍然缺乏对这些基于符号的方法何时以及为何优于普通SGD的理论理解。核心障碍在于，在标准的平滑性和有限方差条件下，SGD已被证明在以ℓ₂-范数度量驻点的优化问题中是极小极大最优的，这从根本上排除了基于符号的方法在标准设置中取得任何复杂度增益的可能性。为克服这一障碍，我们利用ℓ₁-范数平稳性、ℓ∞-平滑性以及可分离噪声模型来分析基于符号的优化器，这些条件能够更好地刻画符号更新的逐坐标特性。在这种独特的问题几何结构下，我们推导出了SignSGD的匹配上下界，并明确刻画了问题的类别……
tldr: 本文通过引入ℓ₁-范数平稳性、ℓ∞-平滑性和可分离噪声模型这一新问题几何框架，首次从理论上证明了SignSGD在何种条件下以及为何能够超越SGD，并给出了匹配的复杂度上下界。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes theoretically when and why SignSGD outperforms SGD by introducing a novel problem geometry based on ℓ₁-norm stationarity, ℓ∞-smoothness, and separable noise, deriving matched upper and lower complexity bounds.
